title: LumenCore External Replication Docket Template
purpose: Pre-register one bounded comparison so an independent evaluator can reproduce, reject, rerun, or advance the result without relying on founder-authored authority.

hypothesis.falsification_condition: Pending explicit condition under which the candidate claim is rejected.

source.name: Pending authorized source or dataset.
source.population: Pending target population or operating envelope.

design.baseline: Pending incumbent, naive, or accepted comparator.
inclusion_rules: Define every inclusion rule before the holdout is revealed.
exclusion_rules: Define every exclusion rule before the holdout is revealed.
design.temporal_or_seed_split: Pending frozen time window, seed set, or sample split.
contamination_controls: Separate development data from the evaluator-controlled holdout.
Record every person and process with access to holdout outcomes before scoring.

analysis.metric_definition: Pending exact equation, units, aggregation, and edge-case handling.
analysis.uncertainty_method: Pending confidence interval, bootstrap, Bayesian interval, or other evaluator-approved method.
analysis.sample_adequacy_plan: Pending power, precision, coverage, or minimum-sample justification.
analysis.multiplicity_policy: One primary metric; predeclare correction or exploratory labeling for secondary analyses.
analysis.missing_data_policy: Pending missingness definition, imputation prohibition or method, and incomplete-window treatment.
analysis.outlier_policy: Pending outlier definition and treatment locked before scoring.
failure_rules: A candidate run that violates a locked safety, integrity, or data-rights rule is a failed run, not a favorable omission.
incomplete_run_rules: Every incomplete run remains in the denominator or is separately reported under the predeclared rule.
stop_rules: Stop on source-rights ambiguity, holdout contamination, code drift, manifest mismatch, or evaluator withdrawal.

reproducibility.tolerance_definition: Pending exact deterministic equality or stochastic tolerance rule.

negative_results: No result exists because this is an unassigned preregistration template.
failure_notes: No run is authorized until the evaluator, source rights, protocol, holdout, code, environment, and analysis plan are frozen.
deviations: No deviations recorded; the protocol is not yet assigned.
limitations: This template does not establish an evaluator, a dataset, a result, external validation, field performance, certification, deployment, or customer adoption.

decision.next_gate: Assign one qualified evaluator and one authorized source before freezing the protocol.

proves: A machine-readable external-replication contract template exists.
The template requires source rights, preregistration, holdout separation, uncertainty, negative results, deviations, and offline verification before a stronger claim.
does_not_prove: Certification, endorsement, deployment, savings, revenue, or customer adoption
claim_boundary.safe_sentence: LumenCore has prepared a fail-closed external-replication docket; no external result exists until a qualified evaluator controls the agreed test and records the outcome.
